description: Header file defining structures, macros, and function prototypes for NVRAM variable manipulation in embedded systems.

methods.name: nvram_set
methods.description: Set the value of an NVRAM variable.

methods.name: nvram_get
methods.description: Get the value of an NVRAM variable.

methods.name: nvram_unset
methods.description: Unset the value of an NVRAM variable.

methods.name: nvram_open
methods.description: Open NVRAM and obtain a handle.

methods.name: nvram_close
methods.description: Close NVRAM handle and free resources.

methods.name: nvram_safe_get
methods.description: Safely get NVRAM variable value, defaulting to empty string if NULL.

methods.name: nvram_calc_crc
methods.description: Calculate crc value of the NVRAM header.

methods.name: nvram_to_staging
methods.description: Copy NVRAM contents to staging file.

methods.name: staging_to_nvram
methods.description: Copy staging file to NVRAM device.
